summary: Azio AI Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a September 25, 2026 standby equity purchase agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. covering a $3.5 million pre-paid advance in two tranches, $3.0 million funded at closing and $0.5 million after resale registration effectiveness. Convertible notes carry 6% interest (18% on default), mature September 25, 2027, and convert at 92% of the lowest five-day VWAP with a $0.26 floor. The 4% discount and unregistered equity sales are routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and registration timing.
